prompt: Create a skill called 'hello-world' that makes Claude greet the user with their name. The skill should: 1) ask for the user's name if not provided, 2) generate a greeting using the name, 3) save the greeting to /tmp/hello-greeting.txt, 4) read it back and display it. Write the skill to ~/.claude/skills/hello-world/SKILL.md with proper frontmatter (name, description).
